title: cMPI: Using CXL Memory Sharing for MPI One-Sided and Two-Sided Inter-Node Communications
problem: MPI cross-node communication uses complex network protocols (TCP, RoCE) with high latency and verification overhead.
motivation: CXL memory sharing offers potential for lower-latency cross-node communication by transforming network communication into memory transactions.
method: cMPI: MPI optimization using CXL memory sharing for point-to-point communication; addresses data object management, cache coherence, atomic operations on real CXL platform.
key_novelty: First work using CXL memory sharing for MPI communication on real CXL platform; memory-based cross-node communication paradigm.
contributions: Data object management for dax representation
Cache coherence and atomic operations support
7.2x-8.1x lower latency vs TCP, 49x-72x improvement for small messages
